opdatering.notice_ready: TimeTrack {version} is ready. Install it under Settings → Updates
opdatering.idle: The app checks for updates by itself
opdatering.available: Version {version} is ready to be installed
opdatering.ready_installer: Version {version} is downloaded. Restart to install it. TimeTrack starts again by itself
opdatering.ready: Version {version} is installed. Restart to use it
opdatering.err.manifest: The update information cannot be read: {error}
opdatering.err.no_platform: There is no update for this computer ({platform})
opdatering.err.signature: The update is not signed by TimeTrack and was rejected ({error})
opdatering.err.install: The update could not be installed: {error}
opdatering.err.no_write: TimeTrack is not allowed to write to {dir}. Download the new version from timetrack.dk and install it yourself
migrering.logged_in: You were signed in to the previous version of TimeTrack. The new version uses a new and more secure sign-in, so you need to sign in again. Your data is still in your account
migrering.unsynced: {count} entries were not synced before you updated. They are saved in the file {file}, so you can create them again
migrering.local_only: Invoices ({invoices}) and rules ({rules}) from the previous version were only on this computer and are not moved to the account. They have not been deleted
migrering.moved: We moved {customers} clients, {projects} projects, {entries} entries and {cards} punch cards from the previous version
migrering.settings: We moved your settings from the previous version
migrering.license: Your license from the previous version must be connected again with the license key
migrering.license_moved: Your lifetime license from the previous version has been moved
migrering.running: A timer was running in the previous version from {start}. It was not moved, so record that time again
migrering.error: We could not move everything from the previous version ({error}). The old folder has not been changed
migrering.skip.from_account: Clients, projects, entries and punch cards are fetched from the account when you sign in
migrering.skip.already: The new database already had clients, so data was not moved again
migrering.skip.cloud_ai: Cloud AI is turned off. Choose a provider and enter the key again under Settings → AI
migrering.skip.card_no_client: The punch card "{name}" has no client and was not moved
migrering.skip.bad_start: An entry with an invalid start time ({start}) was not moved
migrering.skip.running: A timer was running when you updated. It was not moved, so record that time again
migrering.skip.invoice_empty: An invoice without entries was not moved
migrering.skip.pomodoro: The pomodoro history is not moved
afloesning.msi: An old version of TimeTrack (MSI, installed for all users) is still on this computer. Removing it needs administrator rights, so remove it under Settings → Apps → TimeTrack (old version) → Uninstall
afloesning.msi_version: An old version of TimeTrack (MSI, installed for all users) is still on this computer. Removing it needs administrator rights, so remove it under Settings → Apps → TimeTrack (old version) → Uninstall. Pick the one with version {version}
